mapper.sql: select d.id, d.name, d.category_id, d.price, d.original_price, d.unit, d.spec, d.origin, d.shelf_life_days, d.storage_type, d.is_presale, d.stock, d.sales_count, d.image, d.description, d.status, d.update_time, c.name as category_name from product d join category c on d.category_id = c.id
mapper.select: where d.category_id = #{categoryId} and d.status = 1 order by d.create_time

select id from product where status = 1 and id in
#{id}

select image from product where id in
#{id}
select (select count(1) from product where status = 1) as sold, (select count(1) from product where status = 0) as discontinued
